source.publisher: Forex Factory / National Association of REALTORS
source.headline: US NAR Existing-Home Sales Report Shows 2.0% Decrease in August

summary: US existing-home sales fell 2.0% month over month and 1.2% year over year in August. The weaker housing signal marginally supports a softer-growth / lower-rate interpretation, but the live macro regime is dominated by surging oil and Treasury yields, so directional confidence is deliberately low.

learning_profile.basis: ACTIONABLE v2 confidence calibration: low-confidence directional signals are kept restrained; low-confidence MIXED next-session forecasts have stronger evidence.

predictions.mechanism: Weaker housing activity can marginally reduce expected policy tightness and support duration-sensitive equities, but today's inflation/oil/yield shock sharply limits conviction.
predictions.invalidation: Further rise in Treasury yields or renewed Fed-hike repricing overwhelms the housing-growth signal.

predictions.mechanism: Lower housing activity is dovish for rates but negative for cyclical growth, leaving the broad index with opposing forces.
predictions.invalidation: A decisive move in yields or oil creates a dominant directional macro impulse.

predictions.mechanism: Softer housing data modestly supports lower-rate expectations, but a firmer dollar and sharply higher yields cap the gold response.
predictions.invalidation: Dollar and real-yield strength accelerates after the release.
